## What it makes

A short 16:9 product ad in 1080p, made from nothing but a sentence. It is for makers who have a product idea but no photo yet. The idea: let a language model act as the creative director, write one image prompt and one motion prompt, and hand them to three specialists in turn: Seedream paints the hero shot, Seedance brings it to life and vCube upscales and cleans the final clip.

## The workflow

<Shot src="templates/product-ad-in-one-click-workflow.webp" alt="The Product Ad in One Click template in five groups: brief, creative director, hero shot, animate, enhance and save" caption="Five groups from the brief to the saved 1080p ad." />

1. A **Product brief (one line)** text node holds the idea. The template uses a matte-black cold-brew can for busy students.
2. **[BytePlus LLM](../../nodes/byteplus-llm/)** (Seed 2.1 Turbo) answers in the format `IMAGE:` and `MOTION:`. Two **Extract Regex** nodes split the reply, and two **Preview Any** nodes show both prompts.
3. **[Seedream 4.5 & 5.0](../../nodes/seedream/)** (Seedream 5.0 Pro, 16:9 at 2048x1152) paints the hero shot from the image prompt.
4. **[Seedance 2.5 First-Last-Frame to Video](../../nodes/seedance-2-5-first-last-frame/)** with the model set to Seedance 2.0 animates the image as its first frame: 720p, 5 seconds, audio on.
5. An **Extract Regex** node pulls the video link out of the Seedance `response`.
6. **[vCube Video Enhance](../../nodes/vcube-video-enhance/)** takes that link as `video_url` and upscales to 1080p. **Save Video** keeps the result in `BytePlus/Video/ProductAd`.

## Run it

1. Add your ModelArk API key and your AI MediaKit API key in **Settings → BytePlus** if you have not yet ([API keys](../../get-started/api-keys/)). The template needs both.
2. Open the template browser and choose **Product Ad in One Click** under BytePlus.
3. Replace the text in **Product brief (one line)** with your own product and audience.
4. Press **Run**. The two prompts appear first, then the ad is saved.

## Settings worth changing

- **Product brief:** mention the product, the container or look, and who it is for.
- **`model` in the hero shot:** Seedream 5.0 Flash gives a cheaper draft while you tune the brief.
- **`duration` and `generate_audio` in Animate:** the template makes 5 seconds with audio on.
- **`resolution` in vCube:** 1080p here, with `tool_version` standard, `scene` aigc and `enhance_style` hd.
- **System prompt of the LLM:** edit it to change the camera move or the look, for example a handheld style instead of a slow push-in.

## Time and cost

The live test took about 270 seconds, close to 4.5 minutes. The LLM, Seedream and Seedance nodes bill on your ModelArk account, and vCube bills on your AI MediaKit account. Running again with unchanged inputs reuses ComfyUI's cached results and does not bill. vCube reads the Seedance clip from its link, so no Comfy.org login is needed.
